fullPassage: Brains are expensive in terms of energy. Twenty percent of the calories we consume are used to power the brain. So brains try to operate in the most energy-efficient way possible, and that means processing only the minimum amount of information from our senses that we need to navigate the world. Neuroscientists weren't the first to discover that fixing your gaze on something is no guarantee of seeing it. Magicians figured this out long ago. By directing your attention, they perform tricks with their hands in full view. Their actions should give away the game, but they can rest assured that your brain processes only small bits of the visual scene. This all helps to explain the prevalence of traffic accidents in which drivers hit pedestrians in plain view, or collide with cars directly in front of them. In many of these cases, the eyes are pointed in the right direction, but the brain isn't seeing what's really out there.

다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오.
"에너지 측면에서 비용이 많이 든다"
Brains are ___________________.
[조건] (1) expensive, in, terms, of, energy를 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 5단어로 쓸 것 (5단어)

det.korean: 에너지 측면에서 비용이 많이 든다
det.analysis: ✅ expensive in terms of energy: 형용사 + 'in terms of' 관용 전치사구 + 명사. 5단어

questions.passage: So brains try to operate in the most energy-efficient way possible, and that means __________ from our senses that we need to navigate the world.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오.
"최소한의 정보의 양만 처리하는 것"
that means ___________________ from our senses.
[조건] (1) process, only, the, minimum, amount, of, information을 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것 (7단어)
       (3) 필요시 어법에 맞게 변형

det.korean: 최소한의 정보의 양만 처리하는 것
det.analysis: ✅ processing only the minimum amount of information: mean + -ing 관용. process → processing 변형. 7단어

questions.passage: Magicians figured this out long ago. By __________, they perform tricks with their hands in full view.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 [조건]에 맞게 영작하시오.
"당신의 주의를 돌림으로써"
By ___________________, they perform tricks.
[조건] (1) direct, your, attention을 모두 사용
       (2) 정확히 3단어로 쓸 것 (3단어)
       (3) 필요시 어법에 맞게 변형

det.korean: 당신의 주의를 돌림으로써
det.analysis: ✅ directing your attention: 전치사 By 다음 동명사. direct → directing 변형. 3단어
